description: This file defines helper classes and functions for testing an engine control system, including a mock engine class with trigger simulation methods and various assertion utilities.

classes.name: EngineTestHelperBase
classes.description: Base class providing controlled initialization for engine test helpers, allowing better management of setup order.

classes.name: EngineTestHelper
classes.description: Derived class from EngineTestHelperBase that simulates engine trigger signals and provides assertions and control methods for testing engine behavior.

methods.name: EngineTestHelperBase
methods.description: Constructor for the base engine test helper class.

methods.name: EngineTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializes the helper with a specified engine type.

methods.name: applyTriggerShape
methods.description: Simulates applying the trigger signal shape during testing.

methods.name: fireRise
methods.description: Simulates a trigger rise after a specified delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: fireFall
methods.description: Simulates a trigger fall after a specified delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: firePrimaryTriggerRise
methods.description: Simulates the primary trigger rising.

methods.name: firePrimaryTriggerFall
methods.description: Simulates the primary trigger falling.

methods.name: fireTriggerEvents
methods.description: Fires a specified number of trigger events.

methods.name: fireTriggerEventsWithDuration
methods.description: Fires trigger events with a specified delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: fireTriggerEvents2
methods.description: Fires a specified number of trigger events with a delay.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.description: Clears any queued trigger events.

methods.name: assertEvent5
methods.description: Asserts an event at a specific index with expected parameters.

methods.name: assertEvent
methods.description: Asserts an event with specified start time, moment, and a parameter.

methods.name: assertInjectorUpEvent
methods.description: Asserts an injector up event at a specific time.

methods.name: assertInjectorDownEvent
methods.description: Asserts an injector down event at a specific time.

methods.name: assertRpm
methods.description: Checks if the engine RPM matches the expected value.

methods.name: executeActions
methods.description: Executes pending engine actions in the test environment.

methods.name: moveTimeForwardMs
methods.description: Advances simulated time by a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: moveTimeForwardUs
methods.description: Advances simulated time by a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: getTimeNowUs
methods.description: Returns current simulated time in microseconds.
